rows.subtitle: Create Design: an engineer asks in plain words; a real model guides, the code decides.
A question about the company's design rules.
The backend searches the Design Manual first (SQLite full-text search), before the model speaks.
The passages go to the model as a tool result.
The model writes the answer from the passages and cites the manual section.
Now a new design, in one sentence.
The model picks a tool: it proposes the form values it read from the sentence.
Plain code checks the values against the rules. The model cannot overrule it.
The model can only open a card. Nothing is reserved until the engineer clicks.
The click calls the confirm endpoint. Only SapClient talks to SAP.
SAP issues the number, the material and the project. The form locks what SAP owns.
A second confirmed card creates the files, inside the designs folder only.
kicad-cli exports the PDF with the company title block filled in.
Open in KiCad starts KiCad's schematic editor with the new design.
The board was created too. Open PCB starts KiCad's PCB editor with it.
The AI guides. The code decides. The engineer clicks.
